websiteEcosystemEntries.name: AI-Connect
websiteEcosystemEntries.tagline: AI-Connect ties the ecosystem together through communication, routing, notification, permissions, escalation, handoff, and coordination.
websiteEcosystemEntries.purpose: Operate as the connective operating layer inside the Applied Intelligence ecosystem.
websiteEcosystemEntries.identity: AI-Connect is the communication, routing, notification, and permission layer. It connects people, departments, reports, alerts, meetings, permissions, workflows, and agent handoffs so nothing important gets lost between people, departments, or decisions.
owns: system-wide coordination across the Applied Intelligence ecosystem
boundaries: AI-Connect does not replace AI-Trace, AI-CIS, AI-Case, AI-ROI, or AI-RMA.
AI-Connect does not own root cause analysis.
AI-Connect does not own corrective action writing.
AI-Connect does not own continuous improvement logic.
AI-Connect does not own ROI/business case generation.
AI-Connect does not own case study storytelling.
AI-Connect does not own failure analysis ownership.
AI-Connect does not own formatting ownership.

websiteEcosystemEntries.name: AI-Trace
websiteEcosystemEntries.tagline: AI-Trace exposes repeat problems, hidden cost, quality risk, and lost hours so recurring issues stop being patched and start being fixed.
websiteEcosystemEntries.roleRelationship: Core visibility and analytics system under the parent ecosystem.

websiteEcosystemEntries.name: AI-CIS
websiteEcosystemEntries.tagline: AI-CIS captures process breakdowns, protects flow, and drives corrective action before repeat issues become normal.
websiteEcosystemEntries.roleRelationship: Core improvement engine under the parent ecosystem.

websiteEcosystemEntries.name: AI-Case
websiteEcosystemEntries.tagline: AI-Case turns real improvements, technical problem-solving, and process wins into clear case studies that show what was done, why it mattered, and what changed.
websiteEcosystemEntries.roleRelationship: Storytelling and portfolio lane under the parent ecosystem.

websiteEcosystemEntries.name: AI-ROI
websiteEcosystemEntries.tagline: AI-ROI turns validated improvements and equipment opportunities into clear financial justification, showing where capacity, labor, and value can be gained.
websiteEcosystemEntries.roleRelationship: Financial and business-justification lane under the parent ecosystem.

websiteEcosystemEntries.name: AI-RMA
websiteEcosystemEntries.tagline: AI-RMA traces failures back to the source, contains risk, and drives permanent correction instead of repeat damage.
websiteEcosystemEntries.roleRelationship: Containment and corrective-action lane under the parent ecosystem.

websiteEcosystemEntries.name: Document Formatter
websiteEcosystemEntries.tagline: The Document Formatter turns finished outputs into clean, branded documents ready for review, print, or portfolio use.
websiteEcosystemEntries.roleRelationship: Formatting and presentation utility under the ecosystem, with public visibility still somewhat undecided.
